answer: A lotus pond keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must grow one lotus from its own kernel, fed by nectar the agent carries by hand from a distinct meadow flower. The nth fake owes the cube of n drops: the first 1, the second 8, the third 27, so the tenth fake alone owes 1,000 drops and twenty fakes together owe 44,100. Bulk farming fails because one carrier walks one path with one drop per trip and no cart can carry two loads at once, like one beekeeper tending a single hive through one summer. Each drop is gathered fresh, never stored, never bought.
